comment: Single source of truth for the env vars the RUNTIME web process reads from .env. ecosystem.config.cjs builds its pm2 forward-list from this, and assertAppEnv (apps/web/lib/app-env.ts, run at boot from instrumentation.ts) proves each one reached the process. Declare a runtime var here ONCE; do not maintain a second list. EXCLUDES: NODE_ENV (ecosystem sets it directly), MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL / TEST_* (owner + test DBs the app must never hold), NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* / FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID (inlined by Next at build time, not read from the runtime env), LGU_* (ingestion job only).
